text.p: Lithuanian newspapers carried the following reports in their Wednesday editions. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy:
- There are seven candidates to the post of the new director general of national television.
- The interior ministry returned a stolen Mercedes 600 SEL car which was driven by former Interior Minister Romasis Vaitiekunas.
- Lithuania's state loans reached 4.78 billion litas on January 1 1997. It was 1,291 litas per capita.
- The father of Lithuanian President Algirdas Brazauskas, Kazimieras Brazauskas, 91, died on Monday after a long illness.
- Prime Minister Gediminas Vagnorius expects that other countries will follow the example of Sweden and will sign visa-free agreements with Lithuania.
- Fifteen big Western investment banks offer to lead the new $200 million eurobond issue.
-The government will today consider a draft project on prevention of money laundering.
- The government wants to put an end to racketeering and organised crime this year.
